title: Motor Degradation Estimation
description: Estimate induction-motor degradation from three-phase currents and voltages, with no extra sensors.
long_description: This project allows you to train a regression model that estimates insulation-related degradation (0 = healthy, 1 = failure) over an induction motor's lifetime from three-phase currents and voltages sampled at 4 kHz. Data comes from a single 11 kW motor that was thermally overloaded until insulation failure. The model is suitable for predictive-maintenance applications where only the motor terminals can be instrumented; transferring it to other motors typically requires additional data and domain adaptation.
